head: c6531982c43af1445979ce014493c7cfe8b2c214
method: own PowerShell script (scripts/qa-guard-check.ps1) dot-sources scripts/gpu-window-guard.ps1 and calls ConvertFrom-GpuCsvLine / Get-GpuSnapshot directly; run under pwsh 7.6.7 and Windows PowerShell 5.1; delivery dryrun not used for these numbers

invalid_inputs.behaviour: throw GUARD_ABORT: cannot parse nvidia-smi line (need >=3 columns)
throw GUARD_ABORT: cannot parse nvidia-smi column 2 as integer

edge_empty_line.behaviour: PowerShell parameter-binding error because [Parameter(Mandatory)][string]$Line rejects an empty string: 'Cannot bind argument to parameter Line because it is an empty string'
edge_empty_line.note: not part of the acceptance list (missing columns / non-numeric are); only reachable if nvidia-smi returns an empty line, which was not observed; recorded as an observation

live_queries_read_only.note: only read-only nvidia-smi queries; no CUDA context was created by QA

old_behaviour_reproduced.method: re-implemented the parent commit 627b989d parser inline (filter cells matching ^\d+, then [int]) against the live units line
old_behaviour_reproduced.result: throws System.Int32 conversion exception: Cannot convert value "4194 MiB" to type "System.Int32"

conclusion: unit-suffixed and bare-numeric forms both parse; missing column and non-numeric cells raise an explicit GUARD_ABORT (never an Int32 conversion exception). Empty-line edge is a parameter-binding error (observation only).
